caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow ceramic bowl rendered in earthy tones dominated by a reddish-brown color. The bowl features several decorative motifs on both its inner surface and rim, including triangular yellow sections dotted with small red spots, green squiggly lines, and simple leaf or plant shapes in brown and green. The main illustration shows the bowl in a three-quarter perspective, while a smaller inset at the lower left corner provides a top-down view, displaying the symmetrical layout of the decorative elements. Additionally, there is a technical side profile diagram in the upper right corner with measurements, showing the contour of the bowl and its dimensions, which are labeled as 10 3/4 and 6 1/2 units in width and height, respectively. The background is a plain off-white, with the images framed by faint pencil lines.
title: Pa. German Deep Dish
